numinance.kinds.v1.LockedExtension.jsons.description: LockedExtension pins one extension version by what was verified at install, never by what its manifest declares.

digest.description: digest is the content digest the installer recomputed over the package content with manifest.yaml excluded.

h1.description:
h1 is the hash of the unpacked tree: "h1:" plus the standard base64 of a sha256 over the sorted per-file
 sha256 lines (the Go module tree hash), 47 characters.

id.description: id is the plugin_id of the manifest: a reverse-DNS identifier of at least two labels.

permissions_digest.description:
permissions_digest is the digest of the accepted permission set (the canonical form of the manifest's kind, ports and
 capabilities with their intents); a change of it is recomputed from the manifest and shown as a permission diff.

signer.description:
signer is the signer identity verified at install, the OIDC issuer plus subject pair as the manifest declares it;
 a different signer for a locked id is a widening that needs approval.

version.description: version is the strict x.y.z version installed.

zh.description: zh is the hash of the archive as downloaded: "zh:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters of its sha256.

numinance.kinds.v1.LockedExtension.jsons.title: Locked Extension

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
